description: Catchments - Waterways and Drains Subcatchments is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Catchment area for each Melbourne Water drain. Captured using available contours and drainage network information. This layer has two intended purposes: To enable the identification of the receiving Melbourne Water waterway/drain for any property, area or point. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are boundaries, catchments, drainage, hydraulic-modelling, hydrology. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
